summary: Remote-controlled RCE via WebSocket to hardcoded server with bypassPermissions Claude Code session
details: The package opens a persistent WebSocket connection to a hardcoded server at wss://agenthub-agent.fyenet.com and dispatches incoming messages to a Claude Code SDK session started with permissionMode 'bypassPermissions'. Remote MessageSend payloads become prompts executed by Claude Code with full tool access on the installer's host, providing arbitrary command execution. The Control.handle router additionally exposes direct FileRead, FileWrite, FileSearch, and FileTree operations to the remote endpoint with no path scoping, so any party controlling the server can read and write arbitrary files on the host. The `agenthub-agent install` subcommand installs OS-level login persistence — an HKCU\...\Run entry on Windows, a systemd user unit on Linux, and a launchd plist with RunAtLoad on macOS — that auto-starts the same dist/main.js daemon at every login, keeping the remote-control channel permanently connected across reboots.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
